name: Keep Tryin' 2
source:
Keep Tryin' 2 is the 'sequel' to Keep Tryin'.

You play as Saem again...or is it... you're playing with Saem?

Find out.

[From [url=https://lehxra.itch.io/keep-tryin-2]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
《继续努力2》是《继续努力》的“续作”。

你将再次扮演赛姆……又或者说……你是在拿赛姆寻开心？

亲自一探究竟吧。

[摘自[url=https://lehxra.itch.io/keep-tryin-2]itch.io[/url]]
